statistical_unit: The same 27 networks and base are shared by NC, Density and GE; not 81 independent networks
selection: Exploratory: these three guides were selected by the earlier six-guide analysis; they are not three independent validations
dispersion: Historical single-run endpoints only; no seed SD, p-values, confidence intervals or significance tests
threshold_definition: C=ceil(0.01*N), where N is the original processed graph size; count residual trees strictly larger than C; retain newly isolated nodes
association_definition: Spearman with average ranks for ties; leave one network out; partial rank correlation uses rank residuals controlling only delta_fvs_pp; raw and N-normalized tree counts reported separately
interpretation: Descriptive association only; all 27 networks, favourable and unfavourable outcomes, and ties are retained; no causal or universally favourable forest criterion inferred
component_case_definition: Exact static component membership correspondence between saved base/guided FVS candidates, not a denoising chronology, postprocessing trace or causal attribution; links contain shared retained original node IDs; pools are collections of separate components, never single trees

definitions.NC: log(sum(exp(lambda_j))/n), complete adjacency eigenvalues of every residual component merged by log-sum-exp
definitions.Density: 2*m/(n*(n-1)); in a forest m=n-components; zero for n<2
definitions.GE: sum_{i!=j}(1/d_ij)/(n*(n-1)); unreachable pairs contribute zero; exact connected-pair distances; zero for n<2
definitions.residual_denominator: n is every retained residual node, including newly isolated nodes
definitions.forest_distribution_denominator: N is the original processed graph size, not residual n
definitions.K: count of residual trees strictly larger than C=ceil(0.01*N); correlations use delta_K/N
definitions.Q: sum of nodes in residual trees strictly larger than C, divided by N
definitions.L: largest residual tree size divided by N
definitions.changes: guided minus the same base on each network; CFN decrease is improvement
definitions.ties: NC/GE: abs(delta)<=1e-10*max(1,abs(base),abs(guided)); delta_metric is zero for such ties and raw delta is also retained. Density direction uses exact rational comparison. K,Q,L,FVS and CFN directions use integer counts
definitions.association: Spearman average ranks with ties, all leave-one-network-out values, and partial rank residual correlation controlling only delta_fvs_count; no p-values
definitions.statistical_unit: The same 27 networks and base are shared by the three guides; not 81 independent networks
definitions.boundary: Historical saved single-run endpoints; no seed statistics, inference trajectory, postprocessing replay, causal attribution or inferred best original-network topology
